title: Cylinder 5 Above Knock Threshold
plain: The knock sensor has picked up strong knocking (pinging) from cylinder 5. Knocking is fuel burning at the wrong time and can damage the engine if it keeps happening.
symptoms: Check engine light on
Pinging or knocking sound when accelerating
Loss of power as the computer pulls back timing

causes.name: Wrong spark plugs or a faulty knock sensor
Internal engine noise mistaken for knock

checks: Fill up with the fuel octane your owner's manual calls for
Check for cooling, lean-running or other engine codes
fix: Use the right fuel and fix any overheating or lean condition; carbon cleaning or sensor replacement may be needed.
